blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebuano guard Lawrence Mangubat came through with another clutch performance as the Jose Rizal University (JRU) Heavy Bombers eliminated the Letran Knights, 85-79, in Game 2 of their NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball semifinal series on Thursday, November 26, at the SM Mall of Asia Arena. Mangubat, who also buried a crucial three-pointer in JRU’s 102-98 overtime victory in Game 1, once again made his presence felt when it mattered most, helping the Heavy Bombers complete a two-game sweep and secure their first Finals appearance in 18 years.
